name: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (successor to MGNREGA)
period: VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 in force; replaces MGNREGA from 1 July 2026 (MGNREGA operated until 30 June 2026). Guarantee is open-ended under statute.
whyItMatters: This is the largest formula/demand-driven rural transfer available to Sikkim and it has just been restructured: Parliament passed the VB-G RAM G Act in December 2025 (Presidential assent December 2025) replacing MGNREGA from 1 July 2026, raising the employment guarantee from 100 to 125 days per rural household. Works are now concentrated in four thematic domains - water security, rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure, and mitigation of extreme weather events - which map almost exactly onto Sikkim's priorities (drying springs, landslide/extreme-weather mitigation, dispersed rural infrastructure). Sikkim's long-running Dhara Vikas springshed work was historically financed through MGNREGA convergence and can be scaled under the new water-security domain. The Centre released an interim FY2026-27 allocation of Rs 95,692 crore to states, with the first wage instalment of Rs 17,744 crore released in May 2026.

fundingAvailable: National interim allocation for FY2026-27: Rs 95,692.31 crore (first wage instalment Rs 17,744 crore released May 2026). Sikkim's share is determined by its approved labour budget/normative allocation, not a fixed ceiling.
